tool-allow-authenticated:agent_surface:
package surface.policy

default allow := false

allow if input.jwt.sub
tool-role-with-deny-reason:agent_surface:
package surface.policy

default allow := false

allow if input.jwt.role == "admin"

deny_reason := "The caller's token has no role" if not input.jwt.role

deny_reason := sprintf("Role %v may not call this tool", [input.jwt.role]) if {
  input.jwt.role
  input.jwt.role != "admin"
}
